404: template <typename Range>
405: int printf_arg_formatter<Range>::parse_header(const char_type*& it,
406:                                               const char_type* end,
407:                                               format_specs& specs) {
408:   using format_arg = basic_format_arg<context_type>;
409: 
410:   int arg_index = -1;
411:   char_type c = *it;
412:   bool parsed_width = false;
413:   if (c >= '0' && c <= '9') {
414:     // Parse an argument index (if followed by '$') or a width possibly
415:     // preceded with '0' flag(s).
416:     detail::error_handler eh;
417:     int value = parse_nonnegative_int(it, end, eh);
418:     if (it != end && *it == '$') {  // value is an argument index
419:       ++it;
420:       arg_index = value;
421:     } else {
422:       if (c == '0' && specs.fill.size() != 0) specs.fill[0] = '0';
423:       if (value != 0) {
424:         // Nonzero value means that we parsed width and don't need to
425:         // parse flags or width again.
426:         specs.width = value;
427:         parsed_width = true;
428:       }
429:     }
430:   }
431:   if (!parsed_width) {
432:     for (; it != end; ++it) {
433:       bool done = false;
434:       switch (*it) {
435:       case '-':
436:         specs.align = align::left;
437:         break;
438:       case '+':
439:         specs.sign = sign::plus;
440:         break;
441:       case '0':
442:         if (specs.fill.size() != 0) specs.fill[0] = '0';
443:         break;
444:       case ' ':
445:         specs.sign = sign::space;
446:         break;
447:       case '#':
448:         specs.alt = true;
449:         break;
450:       default:
451:         done = true;
452:         break;
453:       }
454:       if (done) break;
455:     }
456:     // Parse width.
457:     if (it != end) {
458:       if (*it >= '0' && *it <= '9') {
459:         detail::error_handler eh;
460:         specs.width = parse_nonnegative_int(it, end, eh);
461:       } else if (*it == '*') {
462:         ++it;
463:         auto& parse_ctx = context_.parse_context();
464:         int width_id = parse_ctx.next_arg_id();
465:         const int max_n = context_.args_.max_size();
466:         format_arg width_arg;
467:         if (width_id < max_n) width_arg = context_.args_.get(width_id);
468:         if (!width_arg) context_.on_error("argument not found");
469:         specs.width = static_cast<int>(visit_format_arg(
470:             detail::printf_width_handler<char_type>(specs), width_arg));
471:       }
472:     }
473:   }
474:   return arg_index;
475: }

477: template <typename OutputIt, typename Char>
478: template <typename ArgFormatter>
479: OutputIt basic_printf_context<OutputIt, Char>::format() {
480:   auto out = this->out();
481:   const Char* start = parse_ctx_.begin();
482:   const Char* end = parse_ctx_.end();
483:   auto it = start;
484:   while (it != end) {
485:     char_type c = *it++;
486:     if (c != '%') continue;
487:     if (it != end && *it == c) {
488:       out = std::copy(start, it, out);
489:       start = ++it;
490:       continue;
491:     }
492:     out = std::copy(start, it - 1, out);
493: 
494:     format_specs specs;
495:     specs.align = align::right;
496: 
497:     ArgFormatter arg_formatter(out, specs, *this);
498:     int arg_index = arg_formatter.parse_header(it, end, specs);
499:     if (arg_index == 0) on_error("argument not found");
500: 
501:     // Parse precision.
502:     if (it != end && *it == '.') {
503:       ++it;
504:       c = it != end ? *it : 0;
505:       if ('0' <= c && c <= '9') {
506:         detail::error_handler eh;
507:         specs.precision = parse_nonnegative_int(it, end, eh);
508:       } else if (c == '*') {
509:         ++it;
510:         specs.precision = static_cast<int>(
511:             visit_format_arg(detail::printf_precision_handler(), get_arg()));
512:       } else {
513:         specs.precision = 0;
514:       }
515:     }
516: 
517:     format_arg arg = get_arg(arg_index);
518:     if (specs.precision >= 0 && arg.type() == detail::type::cstring_type) {
519:       auto str = visit_format_arg(detail::get_cstring<Char>(), arg);
520:       auto str_end = str + specs.precision;
521:       auto nul = std::find(str, str_end, Char());
522:       arg = detail::make_arg<basic_printf_context>(basic_string_view<Char>(
523:           str,
524:           detail::to_unsigned(nul != str_end ? nul - str : specs.precision)));
525:     }
526:     if (specs.alt && visit_format_arg(detail::is_zero_int(), arg))
527:       specs.alt = false;
528:     if (specs.fill[0] == '0') {
529:       if (arg.is_arithmetic())
530:         specs.align = align::numeric;
531:       else
532:         specs.fill[0] = ' ';  // Ignore '0' flag for non-numeric types.
533:     }
534: 
535:     // Parse length and convert the argument to the required type.
536:     c = it != end ? *it++ : 0;
537:     char_type t = it != end ? *it : 0;
538:     using detail::convert_arg;
539:     switch (c) {
540:     case 'h':
541:       if (t == 'h') {
542:         ++it;
543:         t = it != end ? *it : 0;
544:         convert_arg<signed char>(arg, t);
545:       } else {
546:         convert_arg<short>(arg, t);
547:       }
548:       break;
549:     case 'l':
550:       if (t == 'l') {
551:         ++it;
552:         t = it != end ? *it : 0;
553:         convert_arg<long long>(arg, t);
554:       } else {
555:         convert_arg<long>(arg, t);
556:       }
557:       break;
558:     case 'j':
559:       convert_arg<intmax_t>(arg, t);
560:       break;
561:     case 'z':
562:       convert_arg<size_t>(arg, t);
563:       break;
564:     case 't':
565:       convert_arg<std::ptrdiff_t>(arg, t);
566:       break;
567:     case 'L':
568:       // printf produces garbage when 'L' is omitted for long double, no
569:       // need to do the same.
570:       break;
571:     default:
572:       --it;
573:       convert_arg<void>(arg, c);
574:     }
575: 
576:     // Parse type.
577:     if (it == end) FMT_THROW(format_error("invalid format string"));
578:     specs.type = static_cast<char>(*it++);
579:     if (arg.is_integral()) {
580:       // Normalize type.
581:       switch (specs.type) {
582:       case 'i':
583:       case 'u':
584:         specs.type = 'd';
585:         break;
586:       case 'c':
587:         visit_format_arg(detail::char_converter<basic_printf_context>(arg),
588:                          arg);
589:         break;
590:       }
591:     }
592: 
593:     start = it;
594: 
595:     // Format argument.
596:     visit_format_arg(arg_formatter, arg);
597:   }
598:   return std::copy(start, it, out);
599: }

part.text:
Fixed in include/fmt/printf.h:268.

**Root cause:** In `printf_arg_formatter::operator()` for `char_type` arguments, alignment was unconditionally reset to `align::right`, discarding the `align::left` already set by the `-` flag in `parse_header`.

**Fix:** Only force right alignment when the `-` flag wasn't given. `%-5c` now yields `"a    "` (matching `std::printf`), while default right alignment is preserved.

**Validation:** Full `ctest` suite passes (17/17), including `printf-test`, plus a direct check of the issue's exact case (`fmt::sprintf("X%-5cX", 'a')` → `"Xa    X"`).
